about: Amot Investments Ltd. is a real estate investment manager. The firm invests in real estate markets of Israel. Its properties include central bus stations, commercial centers, supermarkets, banks, and other commercial areas. Amot Investments Ltd. is based in Ramat Gan, Israel. Amot Investments Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Alony Hetz Properties & Investments Ltd.
